articles.title: Qualcomm Is Down 10% in a Year. Its CFO Says “Things Can Only Go Up From Here”
articles.description: Key TakeawaysQualcomm stock is down 10% over the past year, after a May rally on AI devices, cars and data centers unwound. Handset revenue fell 20% in the June quarter and Qualcomm’s Apple revenue is fading faster than planned, while automotive revenue grew 61%.
